text:
maria: Heads-up — starting a v2 deprecation sweep for ML inference endpoints next week. Need clear ownership and dependency calls. @kevin @sophie @ajay, can you confirm owners and blockers?
kevin: I'm owner for the runtime adapter. Plan to update the SDK shim — aiming Tue EOD for a patch release.
sophie: We (retrieval service) still rely on the v2 chat schema for convo stitching. If you drop the endpoint we need a compatibility shim or a migration plan.
ajay: Perf tests are failing against the new v2 responses (tokenization timing). Can we get a 1‑week delay on enforcement?
maria: Can you paste the failing test logs here so we can triage quickly?
ajay: Here's the relevant snippet: ```Error: kv-cache miss increased latency from 23ms -> 110ms on sequence length 1024
at infer_pipeline (runtime/exec.go:412)
Message: unexpected token alignment with quantized kernel```
kevin: Quick mitigation: SDK can set header `X-RI-Compat: true` to route to the v2-compatible runtime path while we patch kernels. That should be opt-in so we don't change behavior for everyone.
sophie: That header-based fallback exists for hosted, right? Private/on-prem customers won't get the routing unless their infra is updated.
rachel: Support note — we have 3 private customers with v2 pinned and low tolerance for regressions. I've opened a ticket and flagged AEs.
deploy-bot: canary deployment started on cluster-a2 at 2024-04-12T09:30:00Z for service=runtime-adapter tag=canary-v2-compat
maria: Action items: 1) Kevin - add opt-in `X-RI-Compat` and cut patch release 0.9.2; 2) Sophie - coordinate retriever migration plan and docs; 3) Ajay - run perf regression triage and post results by Thu; 4) Rachel - escalate the private customers and collect expectations. If anyone wants co-owner, ping here.
ajay: :thumbsup: I'll rerun perf harness tonight and share numbers by Thu morning.
kevin: I'll open the PR, include minimal surface area (header check + fallback), and ping eng-releases for a canary slot.
sophie: Docs Q — where should we put the compatibility header reference? API ref or migration guide? I'd prefer both: brief note in API ref + a migration recipe in guides.
maria: Timeline proposal: docs-warning (soft) Mon 2024-04-15; canary roll with opt-in Mon 2024-04-22; enforced cutoff Mon 2024-05-06. Thoughts?
kevin: Sounds reasonable. Since header defaults to off it's safe to ship as a patch (0.9.2 -> 0.9.3 if needed).
sophie: Agreed, prefer patch release if behavior is opt-in.
maria: Great — I'll consolidate into ticket RI-1582 and add owners + checklist. Please flag blockers by EOD today.
kevin: Will do. Opening PR now.
ajay: If perf still looks bad after fallback, I'll propose rolling config to reduce max-seq for retrievers as a short-term throttle.
rachel: I'll update the ticket with customer notes and ETA expectations so PMs/AEs have something to share.
maria: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread for async sync. Ping me for any escalation.
